messages.author: fb5882733e5ff5c5
messages.subject: Can't get past part 1
parts:
Hello,

I am new to GGIR and am working with some files that were already processed in an older version (v 2.6-4). When I run the code that I have with that version, everything works fine. However, after updating to the newest version of GGIR I can't get past part 1. I don't receive any error codes, however even after leaving GGIR running overnight (I'm only processing three files right now), it was still on part 1 when I returned in the morning. I have also tried running just the bare minimum input for GGIR and it still doesn't work.

I am not sure what the issue is, so any help regarding this would be appreciated.

Thanks,

Brianna T.

What sensor brand and data format does this concern?

If that does not solve the issue, can you sent me an example file?

Thanks, Vincent

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Can't get past part 1
parts:
Hi Brianna,

I am not able to reproduce your issue.

Some users have been having using GGIR without packages read.gt3x and GGIRread installed. Make sure those are installed.

What computer are you running it on? Some users report challenges processing cwa data on computing clusters recently. I am not sure what is causing that, so it would be good if you could share more details with the community. Please then explain how fast the code runs on a laptop versus your computing cluster.

If that does not work please try to find a way to identify what is causing the slow speed..

Thanks,
Vincent
